project.name: aira-scanner
project.description: AIRA Scanner is a research tool that detects fail-soft patterns in modern software systems, especially AI-assisted code, across its CLI and Vercel-backed web/API surfaces.

nodes.name: Finding
nodes.summary: Value object representing one JavaScript or TypeScript checker result with rule identity, severity, location, description, and optional snippet.

nodes.name: JSChecker
nodes.summary: Coordinates AST-backed and regex-backed checks over one JavaScript or TypeScript file, deduplicating findings produced by overlapping analysis paths.

nodes.name: Finding
nodes.summary: Value object representing one Python checker result with rule identity, severity, source location, description, and optional evidence snippet.

nodes.name: PythonChecker
nodes.summary: Loads and parses one Python source file, runs the configured fail-soft rule checks, and accumulates location-aware Finding records while making syntax failures explicit.

nodes.name: TestCoverageReport
nodes.summary: Captures per-file test counts, happy-to-failure asymmetry, and any C14 findings produced by test-suite analysis.

nodes.name: C
nodes.summary: Defines the ANSI color constants used to distinguish status, severity, and emphasis in terminal output.

nodes.name: CollectionSummary
nodes.summary: Dataclass representing one collected repository's identity, pinned revision, scan totals, submission state, duplicate status, and recoverable error.

nodes.name: LLMConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass carrying provider selection, model endpoint, timeout, context, and prompt state for one model-assisted scan.

nodes.name: LLMRoutingError
nodes.summary: Domain exception that reports configuration, transport, provider, and aggregate routing failures to callers.

nodes.name: ResearchSubmissionError
nodes.summary: Carries research backend failures with an optional provider HTTP status for CLI-safe reporting and compatibility decisions.

nodes.name: AIRAScanner
nodes.summary: Core scanner service that discovers files, runs static and LLM engines, preserves source locations, and exposes explicit failure results.

nodes.name: AIRAScannerError
nodes.summary: Base exception for scanner failures that the CLI can present without a traceback.

nodes.name: ScanResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass carrying target identity, timestamps, finding and check data, summary counts, and engine metadata across CLI and serialization boundaries.

nodes.name: ScanTargetError
nodes.summary: Signals that a requested scan or output path cannot be used safely.

nodes.name: ScannerExecutionError
nodes.summary: Represents operational failures that occur after scan execution has begun.

nodes.name: ScannerInputError
nodes.summary: Represents invalid scan modes, excluded targets, unsupported files, and other caller-correctable input failures.

nodes.name: CliFailureBehaviorTests
nodes.summary: Groups CLI integration cases that require honest exit status, actionable stderr or JSON, and suppression of internal tracebacks across failure modes.

nodes.name: CliScanIntegrationTests
nodes.summary: Validates scan command behavior end to end for clean files, invalid targets, exclusion emptiness, output paths, unexpected failures, and missing subcommands.

nodes.name: DescribeEmptyScanTests
nodes.summary: Covers human-readable explanations for directories with no source files and files removed by exclusions.

nodes.name: ValidateScanTargetTests
nodes.summary: Covers direct validation of missing, unsupported, supported-file, and directory scan targets.

nodes.name: CollectorTests
nodes.summary: Covers the public-repository collector's manifest ingestion, curated metadata, scan submission, and command-line reporting.

nodes.name: ComparisonTests
nodes.summary: Covers finding-wrapper ingestion and boundary-aware suppression matrix counts for static versus model scan results.

nodes.name: DeterministicScanTests
nodes.summary: Covers deterministic inline scanning behavior and metadata consistency across supported language paths and multiple source files.

nodes.name: ProviderHealthSnapshotTests
nodes.summary: Covers provider discovery and configuration precedence without making live model requests.

nodes.name: ResearchHelpersTests
nodes.summary: Covers research record construction, backend selection, health reporting, submission transports, scoring, deduplication, and CLI integration.

nodes.name: _FakeResponse
nodes.summary: Minimal context-manager response double used to emulate URL request bodies in research backend tests.

nodes.name: PropertyBasedScannerTests
nodes.summary: Uses generated Python source, fail-soft snippets, and exclusion layouts to assert scanner invariants over a broad input space.

nodes.name: ScannerModeTests
nodes.summary: Covers failure handling and result normalization across static, LLM, and hybrid scanner modes.

nodes.name: Aira
nodes.summary: Homebrew Formula subclass declaring AIRA metadata, Python dependencies, virtualenv installation behavior, and an executable smoke test.

nodes.name: handler
nodes.summary: BaseHTTPRequestHandler implementation for CORS preflight and bounded POST requests that expose AIRA deterministic inline scanning over HTTP.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Defines the AIRA package identity and current public version used by the scanner, CLI banner, and serialized output.

nodes.name: __main__.py
nodes.summary: Provides the python -m aira entry point by importing and immediately invoking the CLI main function.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Marks the language-checker directory as a Python package; concrete checker implementations live in sibling modules.

nodes.name: js_checker.py
nodes.summary: Implements JavaScript and TypeScript fail-soft detection through an optional Esprima AST pass followed by regex fallbacks, with deduplication across both analysis paths.
nodes.languageNotes: The checker parses JavaScript with optional Esprima support but retains line-oriented regex checks so unsupported TypeScript syntax can still be scanned.

nodes.name: python_checker.py
nodes.summary: Implements the Python static-analysis engine, combining AST traversal with targeted text heuristics to emit AIRA findings for fail-soft behaviors such as swallowed exceptions, false success, bypasses, and unsafe retries.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Python AST traversal for structural rules and regex scanning for source-local patterns that are not represented directly in the tree.

nodes.name: test_coverage_checker.py
nodes.summary: Detects C14 test-coverage asymmetry by classifying Python and JavaScript test lines as happy-path or failure-path evidence, then reporting heavily skewed suites.

nodes.name: cli.py
nodes.summary: Implements the AIRA command-line surface for scan, health, providers, collection, and static-versus-model comparison workflows. It translates scanner and backend outcomes into stable output formats and automation-safe exit codes.

nodes.name: collector.py
nodes.summary: Drives manifest-based collection of public repositories, repeatable checkout and scanning, optional aggregate research submission, and provenance-manifest persistence.

nodes.name: comparison.py
nodes.summary: Compares deterministic and model-assisted scan artifacts by semantic fingerprint, source location, check, and boundary, then produces suppression and status matrices for research analysis.

nodes.name: deterministic_scan.py
nodes.summary: Adapts inline Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript source payloads into temporary files for the shared AIRAScanner and returns API-friendly findings, summaries, and parser metadata.

nodes.name: finding_metadata.py
nodes.summary: Enriches scanner findings with deterministic source context, boundary classification, and stable semantic, location, and full fingerprints used for location-aware comparison and research analysis.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses precise Python AST containment and heuristic JavaScript context recovery, preserving deterministic metadata when a full parser is unavailable.

nodes.name: llm.py
nodes.summary: Normalizes configuration, health discovery, deterministic JSON prompting, and retry-based routing across local and hosted LLM providers used by model-assisted AIRA scans.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a dataclass configuration object and urllib-based provider adapters to avoid an external HTTP client dependency.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Defines the public research API and routes configuration, health checks, and aggregate submissions across Supabase, JSONL, and legacy Airtable backends.

nodes.name: airtable.py
nodes.summary: Implements the legacy Airtable research backend, including configuration snapshots, connectivity checks, HTTP error translation, and optional-field compatibility fallback.

nodes.name: base.py
nodes.summary: Centralizes research schema constants, FTI weights, backend selection, normalization helpers, and the typed submission error contract.

nodes.name: helpers.py
nodes.summary: Builds deterministic research records from ScanResult data, including per-check counts, FTI scoring, source attribution, fingerprints, and hash-linked persisted payloads.

nodes.name: jsonl_backend.py
nodes.summary: Implements the local JSONL research sink with configuration and writability checks plus append-only, UUID-addressed structured submissions.

nodes.name: supabase.py
nodes.summary: Implements the preferred Supabase backend, including REST requests, duplicate detection, parent-record lineage, submission persistence, and per-check child rows.

nodes.name: scanner.py
nodes.summary: Orchestrates static, provider-assisted, and hybrid scans, normalizes location-rich findings, and serializes ScanResult output. It also owns target validation, exclusions, error findings, check-state aggregation, and LLM response normalization.

nodes.name: verify_aira_packaged_scan.sh
nodes.summary: Performs an isolated packaged-path smoke test by installing the CLI into a temporary virtual environment and verifying both successful JSON output and the operational-failure contract for a missing target.
nodes.languageNotes: Runs with strict Bash error handling but temporarily disables immediate exit to assert expected process codes.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Marks the CLI test directory as a Python package without adding test fixtures or runtime behavior.

nodes.name: fixture_violations.py
nodes.summary: Provides intentionally unsafe Python examples spanning false success, audit loss, ambiguous returns, unsupervised tasks, startup degradation, nondeterminism, and retry hazards for scanner tests.

nodes.name: test_cli_failure_behavior.py
nodes.summary: Exercises the CLI's externally visible exit codes and error payloads for successful scans, invalid inputs, write failures, parser failures, missing LLM configuration, and unexpected exceptions.

nodes.name: test_cli_scan_validation.py
nodes.summary: Tests target validation and empty-scan explanations directly, then verifies the same input and operational failure contracts through the CLI entry point.

nodes.name: test_collector.py
nodes.summary: Validates collection manifests, curated sample metadata hashing, repository scan submission, and the collect command's JSON summary using isolated temporary repositories.

nodes.name: test_comparison.py
nodes.summary: Validates scan JSON loading and construction of suppression matrices that group model misses by check and code boundary.

nodes.name: test_deterministic_scan.py
nodes.summary: Checks deterministic inline scanning across Python and JavaScript, including repeatability, parser-backed rules, location metadata, language aliases, rejection behavior, and multi-file aggregation.

nodes.name: test_llm_routing.py
nodes.summary: Tests provider health configuration resolution for local OpenAI-compatible servers, Ollama, and Groq, including precedence among defaults, environment values, and explicit configuration.

nodes.name: test_research.py
nodes.summary: Covers research aggregation, backend inference and health, JSONL and Supabase submission, schema-v2 records, FTI scoring, duplicate detection, and CLI research reporting.

nodes.name: test_scanner_modes.py
nodes.summary: Exercises static, LLM, and hybrid scan contracts plus property-based invariants for valid syntax, fail-soft detection, exclusions, and complete result shapes.

nodes.name: extension.js
nodes.summary: Implements the VS Code extension lifecycle, launches the packaged AIRA CLI for workspace or file scans, and converts JSON findings into editor diagnostics and user notifications.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CommonJS exports and callback-based child-process execution inside an async extension workflow.

nodes.name: aira.rb
nodes.summary: Defines the Homebrew formula that builds AIRA in an isolated Python virtual environment, installs pinned build resources, exposes the console script, and verifies C03 detection.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Homebrew's Ruby DSL for resources, virtualenv installation, and formula-level testing.

nodes.name: airtable-health.js
nodes.summary: Legacy Airtable health alias that enforces GET/OPTIONS, delegates to the canonical research health service, and annotates the compatibility response.

nodes.name: health.js
nodes.summary: Exposes the Vercel LLM provider health snapshot over a CORS-enabled GET endpoint with explicit preflight and method handling.

nodes.name: research-health.js
nodes.summary: Canonical Vercel health endpoint for the selected research backend, with CORS, method validation, and backend-derived status codes.

nodes.name: research.js
nodes.summary: Vercel submission endpoint that gates public writes, validates POST/OPTIONS, delegates persistence, and converts backend errors into HTTP responses.

nodes.name: scan.js
nodes.summary: Defines the Vercel model-assisted scan route, normalizing legacy prompt shapes and provider overrides before routing requests through the shared JavaScript LLM service.

nodes.name: static-scan.py
nodes.summary: Provides the Python serverless deterministic-scan endpoint, enforcing CORS, payload size, JSON shape, source and language validation before invoking shared inline scanner helpers.

nodes.name: supabase-health.js
nodes.summary: Supabase-oriented health alias that delegates to canonical backend selection while preserving route and preferred-backend metadata.

nodes.name: airtable.js
nodes.summary: Implements the legacy Airtable web backend, including aggregate field shaping, schema-tolerant submission retries, configuration snapshots, and connectivity checks.

nodes.name: llm.js
nodes.summary: Routes web LLM requests across Ollama and hosted providers, validates JSON-only responses, performs local model discovery, and reports provider health.

nodes.name: research-schema-v2.js
nodes.summary: Defines the web research schema and transforms raw submissions into normalized per-check rows, FTI scores, deterministic fingerprints, and hash-linked records.

nodes.name: research-store.js
nodes.summary: Selects the hosted research backend, enforces the public-submission gate, and routes health and write operations between Supabase and legacy Airtable.

nodes.name: supabase.js
nodes.summary: Implements Supabase research persistence with configuration checks, REST helpers, fingerprint deduplication, parent-record lineage, and child check rows.

nodes.name: update_homebrew_formula.py
nodes.summary: Downloads a tagged or commit-pinned GitHub archive, computes its SHA-256 digest, and rewrites the stable URL, version, and checksum fields in the Homebrew formula.

nodes.name: JSChecker.__init__
nodes.summary: Loads source, initializes finding deduplication, and attempts tolerant Esprima module then script parsing while preserving a regex-only fallback.

nodes.name: JSChecker._add
nodes.summary: Deduplicates a prospective result by rule, line, and description before constructing and storing its Finding record.

nodes.name: JSChecker._audit_calls_in_try
nodes.summary: Collects audit- and evidence-related calls plus source locations from a try subtree for loss-of-evidence checks.

nodes.name: JSChecker._check_ambiguous_returns
nodes.summary: Uses bounded function windows to report multiple null, undefined, or false returns that blur the caller-visible outcome contract.

nodes.name: JSChecker._check_ambiguous_returns_ast
nodes.summary: Counts null, false, and undefined returns within parsed functions and reports contracts with multiple indistinguishable absence or failure outcomes.

nodes.name: JSChecker._check_background_tasks
nodes.summary: Detects timers, workers, promise groups, and then chains without nearby catch or try handling.

nodes.name: JSChecker._check_broad_exception_suppression
nodes.summary: Tracks catch braces line by line and flags empty, console-only, or non-propagating catch bodies when structural parsing is unavailable or incomplete.

nodes.name: JSChecker._check_broad_exception_suppression_ast
nodes.summary: Classifies parsed catch clauses as empty, console-only, throwing, or silently absorbing and emits severity-graded C03 findings.

nodes.name: JSChecker._check_bypass_paths
nodes.summary: Scans source for camelCase and snake_case flags that can bypass governance, validation, audit, or checks.

nodes.name: JSChecker._check_confidence_misrepresentation
nodes.summary: Recognizes result-producing function declarations and checks their following source window for confidence metadata.

nodes.name: JSChecker._check_determinism
nodes.summary: Flags non-zero temperature values in JavaScript object properties or assignments used near model calls.

nodes.name: JSChecker._check_environment_safety
nodes.summary: Finds environment-controlled safety switches and development-mode conditionals that can weaken production guarantees.

nodes.name: JSChecker._check_idempotency
nodes.summary: Correlates retry markers with nearby write operations and reports windows that contain no idempotency or deduplication signal.

nodes.name: JSChecker._check_startup_integrity_ast
nodes.summary: Finds startup-like function declarations with non-throwing catch paths that do not terminate the process.

nodes.name: JSChecker._check_success_integrity
nodes.summary: Buffers catch blocks and searches them for true returns, true-valued success objects, and success-like promise resolution.

nodes.name: JSChecker._is_console_only
nodes.summary: Determines whether a catch body is empty or consists exclusively of console calls, a strong signal that the exception is only logged.

nodes.name: JSChecker._iter_nodes
nodes.summary: Recursively yields Esprima nodes across lists and object attributes while ignoring primitive values.

nodes.name: JSChecker._member_name
nodes.summary: Recovers dotted names from Esprima Identifier and MemberExpression nodes for semantic call-site matching.

nodes.name: JSChecker._returns_success_like
nodes.summary: Walks a catch subtree for true returns, true-valued success objects, or promise resolution with true, signaling false-success behavior.

nodes.name: JSChecker.run
nodes.summary: Runs structural checks when parsing succeeds, then executes the line-oriented fallback rule suite and returns deduplicated findings.

nodes.name: PythonChecker.__init__
nodes.summary: Reads a Python file, parses it into an AST, retains syntax-error details rather than aborting, and initializes the finding accumulator.

nodes.name: PythonChecker._add
nodes.summary: Creates a Finding with the rule metadata and source-line snippet, then appends it to this scan's result set.

nodes.name: PythonChecker._check_ambiguous_returns
nodes.summary: Counts None returns within each function while excluding nested function scopes and flags contracts with multiple indistinguishable null outcomes.

nodes.name: PythonChecker._check_audit_integrity
nodes.summary: Correlates audit-like calls inside try bodies with handlers that do not re-raise, identifying possible silent evidence loss.

nodes.name: PythonChecker._check_background_tasks
nodes.summary: Locates create_task and ensure_future calls and asks callers to verify that asynchronous failures are supervised and observable.

nodes.name: PythonChecker._check_broad_exception_suppression
nodes.summary: Finds bare or broad Exception handlers and ranks handlers that pass, only log, or otherwise fail to re-raise as C03 risks.

nodes.name: PythonChecker._check_bypass_paths
nodes.summary: Searches AST identifiers and attributes for known flags that disable validation, governance, audit, or routing guarantees.

nodes.name: PythonChecker._check_confidence_misrepresentation
nodes.summary: Finds result-producing functions whose return expressions contain no confidence, certainty, probability, or provenance-like marker.

nodes.name: PythonChecker._check_determinism
nodes.summary: Detects non-zero model temperature assignments that may introduce nondeterminism into governance or commit decisions.

nodes.name: PythonChecker._check_environment_safety
nodes.summary: Scans source lines for environment-specific branches and bypass language that can make safety guarantees drift between deployments.

nodes.name: PythonChecker._check_fallback_scatter
nodes.summary: Finds fallback and degraded-mode identifiers in the AST so distributed fail-open behavior can be reviewed for centralized governance.

nodes.name: PythonChecker._check_idempotency
nodes.summary: Looks around retry indicators for nearby write operations and suppresses C15 only when the cleaned code window contains an idempotency safeguard.

nodes.name: PythonChecker._check_startup_integrity
nodes.summary: Examines startup-like functions for exception handlers that neither raise nor terminate, exposing partially initialized execution paths.

nodes.name: PythonChecker._check_success_integrity
nodes.summary: Inspects exception handlers for true or success-shaped dictionary returns that could falsely report a failed operation as successful.

nodes.name: PythonChecker._strip_comments_and_strings
nodes.summary: Lexically removes Python comments, regular strings, triple-quoted strings, and f-strings so rule regexes do not treat prose as executable evidence.

nodes.name: PythonChecker.run
nodes.summary: Surfaces parse failures as SCANNER findings or executes the complete Python rule pipeline in a fixed deterministic order.

nodes.name: _scanner_error_finding
nodes.summary: Builds an explicit high-severity SCANNER finding when a test file cannot be analyzed.

nodes.name: analyze_test_file
nodes.summary: Counts happy, failure, and generic test evidence in one file, computes an asymmetry ratio, and emits C14 when failure paths are substantially underrepresented.

nodes.name: is_test_file
nodes.summary: Classifies paths as Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript tests using the module's filename and directory regexes.

nodes.name: scan_test_files
nodes.summary: Scans either a single path or a directory tree, applies caller exclusions, analyzes recognized tests, and converts per-file failures into scanner findings.

nodes.name: add_llm_arguments
nodes.summary: Adds shared engine, provider, model, endpoint, timeout, and context-limit options to a command parser.

nodes.name: add_research_arguments
nodes.summary: Adds aggregate submission, backend timeout, sample identity, attribution, and source metadata options to a parser.

nodes.name: build_llm_config
nodes.summary: Translates parsed CLI options into an LLMConfig with provider, model, endpoint, timeout, and context limits.

nodes.name: build_parser
nodes.summary: Builds the required-subcommand argparse tree for scanning, health checks, provider discovery, public collection, and result comparison.

nodes.name: exit_code_for_llm_error
nodes.summary: Maps provider configuration mistakes to usage failure and other routing failures to the operational exit code.

nodes.name: exit_code_for_result
nodes.summary: Computes automation-safe success, usage, or findings-threshold exit status from scanner errors and configured severity.

nodes.name: has_scanner_errors
nodes.summary: Detects whether a ScanResult contains operational SCANNER findings rather than ordinary audit findings.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Routes parsed commands through scanner, provider, research, collection, and comparison workflows while preserving output contracts and distinct exit-code semantics.

nodes.name: positive_int
nodes.summary: Creates an argparse converter that rejects non-integer and non-positive option values with flag-specific messages.

nodes.name: print_banner
nodes.summary: Prints the versioned ANSI AIRA banner for interactive commands.

nodes.name: print_check_results
nodes.summary: Prints each check status with a normalized label and status-specific terminal color.

nodes.name: print_collection_summary
nodes.summary: Reports public-repository sampling metadata and per-sample commit, finding, submission, duplicate, and error state.

nodes.name: print_comparison_summary
nodes.summary: Renders static-versus-model finding ratios, suppression counts, matches, misses, and missed boundary categories.

nodes.name: print_findings
nodes.summary: Groups findings by check and prints severity, exact location, description, and optional source snippet, with explicit no-findings guidance.

nodes.name: print_health
nodes.summary: Displays configured provider order, selected models, endpoints, availability, and static-fallback state.

nodes.name: print_human_review_notice
nodes.summary: Explains that parallel-logic drift and source-lineage checks remain human-review obligations.

nodes.name: print_providers
nodes.summary: Documents supported local and hosted LLM providers, their environment variables, and the recommended selection order.

nodes.name: print_research_health
nodes.summary: Displays research backend selection, configuration, reachability, storage target, and legacy-fallback status.

nodes.name: print_research_submission_error
nodes.summary: Writes a clearly labeled research-submission failure to stderr.

nodes.name: print_research_submission_status
nodes.summary: Reports successful research persistence, including backend, record identifier, fallback mode, and dropped optional fields.

nodes.name: print_summary
nodes.summary: Renders scan counts, severity totals, check outcomes, provider metadata, truncation, and operational notes for humans.

nodes.name: write_text_output
nodes.summary: Writes requested output only when the parent directory exists and converts OS write failures into ScanTargetError.

nodes.name: _clone_sample_repo
nodes.summary: Creates a shallow repository checkout, optionally fetches a requested ref, and records the resolved commit SHA for reproducible scanning.

nodes.name: _infer_repo_slug
nodes.summary: Normalizes owner/repository, SSH, and GitHub HTTP references into a stable repository slug for source identity and checkout naming.

nodes.name: _submission_options_for_sample
nodes.summary: Combines sample metadata, manifest defaults, environment versions, and scanner defaults into normalized aggregate-submission options.

nodes.name: build_sample_manifest_record
nodes.summary: Builds a canonical provenance record from collection and sample metadata, hashes the complete record, and returns the storage schema fields.

nodes.name: collect_public_repos
nodes.summary: Processes each manifest sample through checkout, AIRA scanning, optional aggregate and provenance submission, per-sample error capture, and deterministic cleanup before returning collection results.

nodes.name: load_collection_manifest
nodes.summary: Loads a JSON or YAML collection manifest and enforces a non-empty sample set plus required sampling and attribution metadata.

nodes.name: submit_sample_manifest
nodes.summary: Validates Supabase manifest credentials and upserts a provenance record on sample name and version conflicts.

nodes.name: _compact_finding
nodes.summary: Projects a full finding into the stable fields needed in comparison reports while defaulting absent boundary and fingerprint metadata.

nodes.name: _match_static_finding
nodes.summary: Conservatively matches one static finding to model findings using semantic identity first, then same-file check and boundary proximity windows.

nodes.name: _status_category
nodes.summary: Classifies static-versus-model check statuses into suppression, agreement, model-only, or no-static-failure categories.

nodes.name: build_suppression_matrix
nodes.summary: Matches findings across static and model scans, aggregates per-check and per-boundary coverage, identifies misses and model-only findings, and computes a check-status suppression matrix.

nodes.name: extract_scan
nodes.summary: Normalizes supported direct and wrapped result payloads into one AIRA scan object and rejects unrelated inputs.

nodes.name: load_scan
nodes.summary: Loads a JSON or JSONL scan artifact from disk and normalizes its wrapper shape through extract_scan.

nodes.name: _build_summary
nodes.summary: Converts ScanResult counters and human-review requirements into the compact summary schema consumed by server routes.

nodes.name: _metadata_for_languages
nodes.summary: Describes the deterministic engine and parser backing for homogeneous or mixed Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript input sets.

nodes.name: _resolved_output_path
nodes.summary: Validates an inline source path against absolute and traversal escapes, preserves supported suffixes, and infers an extension from the requested language.

nodes.name: scan_inline_source
nodes.summary: Validates one source language and delegates a synthetic single-file payload to scan_inline_sources.

nodes.name: scan_inline_sources
nodes.summary: Materializes validated inline sources in an isolated temporary tree, runs shared static checks, and serializes location-rich findings plus engine and language metadata.

nodes.name: _fingerprint_payload
nodes.summary: Selects normalized rule, file, line, snippet, and enclosing-scope fields for deterministic finding identity.

nodes.name: _generic_context
nodes.summary: Returns a parser-unavailable context record with line count and normalized line position for unsupported or missing source.

nodes.name: _javascript_context
nodes.summary: Infers nearby JavaScript function, class, try, catch, and return context from declarations preceding a finding and a bounded local source window.

nodes.name: _python_context
nodes.summary: Parses Python source and derives the AST containment path, nearest function, class, block, and normalized file position for a finding line.

nodes.name: build_context
nodes.summary: Loads source when necessary, infers language from an explicit hint or path suffix, and dispatches to Python, JavaScript, or generic context extraction.

nodes.name: enrich_finding
nodes.summary: Adds context, boundary type, three complementary fingerprints, and normalized evidence classification while preserving caller-supplied metadata.

nodes.name: infer_boundary_type
nodes.summary: Combines check identity, finding text, AST path, and enclosing function name to classify the operational boundary represented by a result.

nodes.name: normalize_snippet
nodes.summary: Normalizes arbitrary snippet values to stable single-space text for reproducible evidence and fingerprints.

nodes.name: _call_ollama

nodes.name: _call_openai_compatible

nodes.name: _call_openrouter
nodes.summary: Invokes OpenRouter's chat-completions endpoint and validates its deterministic response against the shared JSON text contract.

nodes.name: _is_configured
nodes.summary: Applies provider-specific readiness requirements for endpoints, models, and API keys before routing an audit request.

nodes.name: _ollama_snapshot
nodes.summary: Builds an Ollama readiness snapshot by discovering installed models and reporting endpoint reachability and selected-model availability.

nodes.name: _provider_api_key
nodes.summary: Selects a provider API credential from AIRA-prefixed and conventional environment variable names.

nodes.name: _provider_base_url
nodes.summary: Resolves and normalizes the HTTP base URL for configurable local, OpenAI-compatible, and NVIDIA provider endpoints.

nodes.name: _provider_model
nodes.summary: Resolves a provider model from an explicit configuration override, provider-specific environment variables, or selected provider defaults.

nodes.name: _request_json
nodes.summary: Executes a JSON HTTP request, decodes the response, and converts HTTP or URL transport failures into LLMRoutingError instances with provider messages.

nodes.name: _runner_for
nodes.summary: Maps a provider identifier to its normalized request adapter and rejects unsupported providers explicitly.

nodes.name: provider_health_snapshot
nodes.summary: Returns a normalized inventory of configured providers, model and endpoint selections, auto-routing order, Ollama discovery status, and static fallback availability.

nodes.name: run_llm_json_audit
nodes.summary: Runs an audit against the selected provider order, attempts each provider twice, returns the first valid JSON result, and aggregates all provider errors on exhaustion.

nodes.name: check_research_connection
nodes.summary: Runs the selected backend's connectivity check and returns a normalized health record with explicit invalid, unconfigured, and legacy-fallback states.

nodes.name: research_backend_snapshot
nodes.summary: Selects the active research backend and combines common preference metadata with that backend's configuration snapshot.

nodes.name: submit_aggregate_research
nodes.summary: Dispatches an aggregate ScanResult submission to Supabase, JSONL, or Airtable and rejects invalid or missing backend configuration.

nodes.name: _airtable_request_json
nodes.summary: Executes an authenticated Airtable JSON request and converts HTTP or transport errors into ResearchSubmissionError with status context.

nodes.name: _submit_aggregate_research_airtable
nodes.summary: Posts baseline and optional aggregate fields, retrying 422 schema failures only by dropping unknown optional fields while preserving required-field failures.

nodes.name: airtable_config_snapshot

layers.name: Delivery Interfaces
layers.description: Exposes AIRA through the command line, VS Code diagnostics, and Vercel HTTP routes while translating user requests into scanner, provider, and research operations.

layers.name: Scanning and Analysis Core
layers.description: Implements deterministic and hybrid scan orchestration, language-specific fail-soft rules, test asymmetry detection, inline-source adaptation, and location-aware finding metadata.

layers.name: Provider Integration Layer
layers.description: Normalizes model-provider configuration, health discovery, deterministic requests, retries, and JSON response validation for Python and web scan paths.

layers.name: Research Services Layer
layers.description: Implements repository collection, scan comparison, research record construction, backend selection, and Airtable, JSONL, and Supabase persistence across Python and web runtimes.

layers.name: Verification Layer
layers.description: Validates scanner rules, CLI failure contracts, engine modes, provider routing, research submissions, comparison workflows, collection behavior, and packaged installation paths.

layers.name: Packaging and Release Layer
layers.description: Defines package identity and automates Homebrew installation metadata, archive checksum updates, and release-time distribution configuration.

tour.title: CLI Launch and Contracts
tour.description: Start with the command-line surface, the topology's strongest entry-point candidate and the place where scan, health, collection, research, and comparison workflows meet. The tiny __main__ module delegates python -m aira execution to main, while main preserves distinct usage, findings-threshold, and operational exit codes so automation can trust the result.
tour.languageLesson: Python's __main__.py convention turns a package into a python -m executable without duplicating command logic.

tour.title: Scan Orchestration Core
tour.description: From the CLI, follow execution into AIRAScanner, the graph's highest-fan-in file and central coordination service. It validates targets, dispatches static, LLM, or hybrid modes, makes scanner failures explicit, and returns a ScanResult that remains stable across terminal and serialization boundaries.

tour.title: Static Detection Engines
tour.description: The scanner delegates language-specific work to Python and JavaScript/TypeScript engines, then adds test-coverage asymmetry analysis. Read these together to see how AST-backed checks and bounded text heuristics detect swallowed exceptions, false success, bypasses, unsafe retries, and other fail-soft patterns while retaining deterministic rule order.
tour.languageLesson: Python's ast module provides structured exception and return analysis, while tolerant Esprima parsing gives JavaScript a structural path with regex fallbacks for unsupported syntax.

tour.title: Location-Aware Evidence
tour.description: Detection becomes useful research evidence only after findings are enriched with boundary types, semantic fingerprints, and stable location identities. The comparison module then matches static and model findings conservatively by semantic identity, check, boundary, file, and line window, exposing recurring misses instead of treating each alert as an isolated reaction.

tour.title: Model-Assisted Routing
tour.description: The optional provider layer extends the deterministic core without replacing it. LLMConfig normalizes provider choices and run_llm_json_audit applies deterministic JSON prompting, provider ordering, bounded retries, and aggregate failure reporting so hybrid scans can fall back visibly rather than silently weakening guarantees.

tour.title: Research and Collection
tour.description: Building on normalized ScanResult data, the research API selects a backend while helper functions create versioned, fingerprinted, hash-linked submission records and per-check metrics. The collector adds reproducible public-repository checkout, commit attribution, optional submission, and per-sample error capture, turning scanner output into a longitudinal dataset.

tour.title: Browser and API Delivery
tour.description: The browser-facing Vercel routes expose two paths through the same architecture: deterministic inline scanning through the Python adapter and model-assisted scanning through the JavaScript provider service. The endpoints enforce method, CORS, payload, and input contracts at the boundary, while health reporting makes provider readiness observable before a scan begins.

tour.title: Editor Delivery
tour.description: The VS Code extension is a second user-facing entry point that deliberately reuses the packaged CLI rather than reimplementing scanning. Its scanTarget workflow manages process and temporary-file boundaries, and applyDiagnostics maps location-rich findings into severity-filtered editor diagnostics.

tour.title: Verification and Release
tour.description: Finish with the contracts that keep every preceding layer honest: scanner-mode tests cover explicit failures and hybrid behavior, while comparison tests protect location-aware suppression analysis. The packaged smoke test, Homebrew formula, and update script verify that the installed console path detects a real violation and that releases remain pinned by immutable archive metadata.
